e.title: Hull-White ESG Checks (OSM)
e.summary: Hull-White 经济情景生成器校验 Python（OSM）：随机利率情景的验证工具
e.body: Hull-White stochastic scenarios checks 是 Ronald Richman（OSM）的 Python 工具：对 Hull-White 经济情景生成器（ESG）生成的随机利率情景做校验（矩匹配、分布检验等）——ESG 验证是偿付能力/ALM 建模的关键环节（模型输出必须先验证再使用）。对 RIAA：ESG 验证方法论的参考实现。与 [[esg]]/[[pyesg]]/[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]（ESG 生成）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[open-source-economic-model]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：OSM（Ronald Richman）Hull-White ESG 随机情景校验 Python
e.summary_en: Python checks for Hull-White economic scenario generator outputs (OSM/Richman): validation of stochastic interest-rate scenarios
e.summary_hk: Hull-White 經濟情景生成器校驗 Python（OSM）：隨機利率情景的驗證工具
e.body_en: Hull-White stochastic scenarios checks is Ronald Richman's (OSM) Python tool for validating Hull-White economic scenario generator (ESG) outputs — moment matching, distribution tests and more; ESG validation is a critical step in solvency/ALM modelling (validate before use). For RIAA: a reference implementation of ESG-validation methodology. Complements [[esg]]/[[pyesg]]/[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]] (ESG generation). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]], [[open-source-economic-model]].
e.body_hk: Hull-White stochastic scenarios checks 是 Ronald Richman（OSM）的 Python 工具：對 Hull-White 經濟情景生成器（ESG）生成的隨機利率情景做校驗（矩匹配、分佈檢驗等）——ESG 驗證是償付能力/ALM 建模的關鍵環節（模型輸出必須先驗證再使用）。對 RIAA：ESG 驗證方法論的參考實現。與 [[esg]]/[[pyesg]]/[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]（ESG 生成）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[open-source-economic-model]]。
